Claude Watch Rust migration

Feature and behavior reference:
https://github.com/YOURSJEYO/claude-switcher
The pinned revisions and reference details are recorded in UPSTREAM.json.
The upstream MIT notice is retained in LICENSE.

The Rust candidate implements the adapted runtime behavior through Claude
Watch's shared Rust services. It does not bundle or execute the former Python
backend, the original account shell engine, or the legacy baseline/preflight
commands. Existing account and transaction formats are read only as needed
by the common account and recovery services.

The fixed watch-admin.sh system adapter and native Swift components remain
for privileged macOS actions and operating-system interfaces. They do not
provide an alternate launch authorization or protection policy.
